description:
Cal.com AI Agent allows this AI Digital Employee to securely connect with Cal.com and manage scheduling using natural language.
The agent can list/create/cancel/reschedule/confirm/decline bookings, add guests, check available time slots, manage event types and schedules, view connected calendars and busy times, manage out-of-office entries and webhooks, read/update the profile, and view team bookings/event types/memberships, strictly based on the permissions granted to the connected Cal.com credentials while maintaining privacy, security, and reliable scheduling operations.

triggers.description: Fires on Cal.com's BOOKING_CREATED webhook event. Requires a webhook already configured on the Cal.com account (nested-format payload) pointed at this trigger's callback endpoint -- this trigger does not call Cal.com's webhooks API itself.

event_type_id.description: Cal.com event type id to scope this trigger to a single event type. Required -- used to identify which subscription an inbound webhook belongs to.
